title: Saudi Arabian Lamb Pilaf
description: A flavorful dish from Saudi Arabia, combining lamb with a nutty pilaf.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the pre-cooked pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Add the Saudi Arabian spice blend, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the skillet and stir to combine with the pilaf mixture.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the lamb is cooked through.
